messages:
Ingrid H: hey sec — need a short elev to pull telemetry logs for privacy QA. will run ~30m. question: will the log pull auto-redact IPs/PII or do i need to run our redact tool locally? ticket will be created, just checking scope before requesting break-glass.

sec-bot: reminder: please use the JIT elevation flow with justification + approver. docs: https://redwood.sec/policy/jit-elev. include exact command and time window in the ticket.

Matt R: i can pair on the pull. what command are you running? we should avoid exporting raw JSON with user identifiers.

Ingrid H: command i'm planning: ``rbx logs export --service telemetry --start '2026-03-16T22:00Z' --end '2026-03-16T22:30Z' --format json`` — i was going to pipe through redact: ``| redact-logs --rules privacy``

Kia S: :eyes: okay but do NOT run a raw export to external storage. prefer `--redact` inline or run `redact-logs` inside the same ephemeral container so PII never lands in S3. also add data retention tag and note if KMS unwrap will be needed. approver: @KiaS or @MattR after ticket is filed. reason should be: "privacy-sample for regression test".

ops-oncall: for JIT we need exact CIDR and role names. suggest 1h window and ephemeral role `logs-reader-temp`. i'll populate the request form. enable audit logging: `audit.logging=true` on the session.

Ingrid H: ok creating ticket PRIV-4782, window 2026-03-17T15:00-15:30 UTC. i'll run in ephemeral pod with `--redact` first then run the local filter. pinging @KiaS for approval.

Kia S: approved on condition you do NOT copy raw outputs off-network. attach the redacted sample to PRIV-4782 and mark retention 7d. :white_check_mark:

Matt R: i'll be available to jump on if you hit errors. :thumbsup:

Ingrid H: thanks all — filing request now.
